relations.subject: George Luzerne Hart, III
relations.evidence: George Luzerne Hart, III (born c. 1942) is Professor Emeritus of Tamil language at the University of California, Berkeley.

relations.subject: George Luzerne Hart, III
relations.evidence: Hart received his PhD in Sanskrit from Harvard University in 1971.

relations.subject: George Luzerne Hart, III
relations.evidence: He taught Sanskrit at the University of Wisconsin–Madison before joining the faculty at the University of California, Berkeley

relations.subject: George Luzerne Hart, III
relations.evidence: joining the faculty at the University of California, Berkeley, where he founded the Tamil Department.

relations.subject: George Luzerne Hart, III
relations.evidence: He is married to Kausalya Hart, who is also a professor and Tamil textbook author.
